{{- $homeURL := site.Home.Permalink -}} {{- $organizationID := printf "%s#organization" $homeURL -}} {{- $websiteID := printf "%s#website" $homeURL -}} {{- $productID := printf "%s#product" $homeURL -}} {{- $pageID := printf "%s#webpage" .Permalink -}} {{- $siteName := site.Params.brandName | default site.Title -}} {{- $title := site.Params.seoTitle | default site.Title -}} {{- $pageName := .Title -}} {{- if not .IsHome -}} {{- if not $pageName }}{{ $pageName = .Section | humanize }}{{ end -}} {{- $title = printf "%s | %s Guide" $pageName $siteName -}} {{- end -}} {{- $description := site.Params.description -}} {{- if not .IsHome -}} {{- $description = .Params.description | default .Params.short | default .Summary | default site.Params.description -}} {{- end -}} {{- $description = trim ($description | plainify | htmlUnescape) " \t\r\n" | truncate 160 -}} {{- $imageURL := (site.Params.socialImage | absURL) -}} {{- $organization := dict "@type" "Organization" "@id" $organizationID "name" site.Params.author "url" site.Params.organizationURL "logo" (dict "@type" "ImageObject" "url" ("static/apple-icon-180x180.webp" | absURL) "width" 180 "height" 180) "sameAs" (slice "https://github.com/schollz/_core" "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FZ2C9VIMgeI&list=PLCNN6FnBNdpWQUyHAQO_wCQkbMl95-293") -}} {{- $website := dict "@type" "WebSite" "@id" $websiteID "url" $homeURL "name" $siteName "alternateName" "Zeptocore handheld sampler" "description" site.Params.description "inLanguage" site.Language.LanguageCode "publisher" (dict "@id" $organizationID) -}} {{- $webPage := dict "@type" "WebPage" "@id" $pageID "url" .Permalink "name" $title "description" $description "inLanguage" site.Language.LanguageCode "isPartOf" (dict "@id" $websiteID) "primaryImageOfPage" (dict "@type" "ImageObject" "url" $imageURL "width" 1600 "height" 672 "caption" site.Params.socialImageAlt) -}} {{- $graph := slice $organization $website $webPage -}} {{- if .IsHome -}} {{- $reviews := slice -}} {{- range site.Data.reviews -}} {{- $reviews = $reviews | append (dict "@type" "Review" "reviewBody" .reviewBody "author" (dict "@type" "Person" "name" "Anonymous reviewer") "reviewRating" (dict "@type" "Rating" "ratingValue" .ratingValue "bestRating" 5 "worstRating" 1 ) ) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $product := dict "@type" "Product" "@id" $productID "name" "Zeptocore" "url" $homeURL "description" site.Params.description "image" (slice $imageURL) "category" "Handheld music sampler and sequencer" "brand" (dict "@type" "Brand" "name" "Zeptocore") "manufacturer" (dict "@id" $organizationID) "countryOfOrigin" (dict "@type" "Country" "name" "United States") "sameAs" "https://github.com/schollz/_core" "aggregateRating" (dict "@type" "AggregateRating" "ratingValue" 5 "bestRating" 5 "worstRating" 1 "ratingCount" (len $reviews) "reviewCount" (len $reviews) ) "review" $reviews -}} {{- $graph = $graph | append $product -}} {{- $questions := slice -}} {{- range where site.RegularPages "Section" "questions" -}} {{- $answer := trim (.Content | plainify | htmlUnescape) " \t\r\n" -}} {{- if and .Title $answer -}} {{- $questions = $questions | append (dict "@type" "Question" "name" .Title "acceptedAnswer" (dict "@type" "Answer" "text" $answer) ) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if gt (len $questions) 0 -}} {{- $faq := dict "@type" "FAQPage" "@id" (printf "%s#faq" $homeURL) "url" (printf "%s#questions" $homeURL) "name" "Zeptocore frequently asked questions" "inLanguage" site.Language.LanguageCode "mainEntity" $questions "isPartOf" (dict "@id" $websiteID) -}} {{- $graph = $graph | append $faq -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- $article := dict "@type" "TechArticle" "@id" (printf "%s#article" .Permalink) "headline" $pageName "description" $description "url" .Permalink "mainEntityOfPage" (dict "@id" $pageID) "image" $imageURL "inLanguage" site.Language.LanguageCode "author" (dict "@id" $organizationID) "publisher" (dict "@id" $organizationID) -}} {{- if not .PublishDate.IsZero -}} {{- $article = merge $article (dict "datePublished" (.PublishDate.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00")) -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not .Lastmod.IsZero -}} {{- $article = merge $article (dict "dateModified" (.Lastmod.Format "2006-01-02T15:04:05Z07:00")) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $breadcrumb := dict "@type" "BreadcrumbList" "@id" (printf "%s#breadcrumb" .Permalink) "itemListElement" (slice (dict "@type" "ListItem" "position" 1 "name" "Zeptocore" "item" $homeURL) (dict "@type" "ListItem" "position" 2 "name" $pageName "item" .Permalink) ) -}} {{- $graph = $graph | append $article | append $breadcrumb -}} {{- end -}}
